blackdetect_note: Log line only when segment >= min_duration (default 2.0s); metadata added regardless. filters.texi lines 8682-8693. Short transitions are silent in log output.
freezedetect_note: freeze_start key set on one frame, holds timestamp of another frame. filters.texi lines 14556-14561. Consuming code must read the key value, not the frame timestamp.
